author: InfiniteJestt
body:
Hello There Avicans!

My friend and I made a map, Travestia, but the plugin we used (MultiVerse) made the map file corrupt, so we switched plugins to MultiWorld, and remade the map, so here is the updated version of it!

Big Thanks to: resepignev! For helping a lot with the YAML File :D Thanks again!

P.S.
If making a map, don't use MultiVerse :D
YAML: http://54.186.53.46/travestia.yaml

Map Download: http://54.186.53.46/travestia.tar.gz
Screenshots:
